Hi Priya / Tom —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, we'd like to run a focused packaging/pricing review with your engineering and procurement teams that covers: usage forecasts, a recommended Dedicated sizing profile, and optional add-ons (retention/observability).

Proposed agenda (45–60m):
- 5m: introductions + goal alignment
- 15m: usage forecast & expected peak patterns (your side)
- 15m: Redwood suggested packaging & Dedicated sizing (SE)
- 10m: commercial terms & procurement checklist (AE + ops)
- 5m: next steps / action items

Availability this week: Tue 12/15 10:00–11:00 PT, Wed 12/16 14:00–15:00 PT. If neither works, share a couple of slots and well coordinate. Ill include the playbook and a forecast template for you to populate ahead of the call.

Attachments: redwood_packaging_playbook_v2.pdf, usage_forecast_2027.xlsx (sample)

Thanks —
Aditya

Priya — great, wed 12/16 at 14:00 PT is fine from the SE side. A couple of notes from the tech agenda so we can be efficient:
- Please include 1–2 representative request traces or average prompt lengths if possible (helps sizing GPU RAM and KV cache).
- If you have concurrent user estimates (QPS) thats helpful for throughput planning.
- Ill bring a short slide on Dedicated sizing options (1/2/4 GPU pools) and the latency/cost tradeoffs for typical FinServ workloads.

Ive attached a short checklist (in the playbook PDF) for SOC2 evidence the security team may ask for — if you want we can set a separate 30m follow-up for security deep-dive.

—Steph
